memberdef.name: decode

briefdescription.para: translateInstruction - Translates an internal instruction and all its operands to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - The MCInst to populate with the instruction's data.

briefdescription.para: translateRegister - Translates an internal register to the appropriate LLVM register, and appends it as an operand to an MCInst.
translateSrcIndex - Appends a source index operand to an MCInst.
translateDstIndex - Appends a destination index operand to an MCInst.

memberdef.argsstring: (MCInst &mcInst, uint64_t immediate, const OperandSpecifier &operand, InternalInstruction &insn, const MCDisassembler *Dis)
memberdef.name: translateImmediate

briefdescription.para: translateImmediate - Appends an immediate operand to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - The operand, as stored in the descriptor table.

briefdescription.para: translateRMRegister - Translates a register stored in the R/M field of the ModR/M byte to its LLVM equivalent and appends it to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - The internal instruction to extract the R/M field from.

briefdescription.para: translateRMMemory - Translates a memory operand stored in the Mod and R/M fields of an internal instruction (and possibly its SIB byte) to a memory operand in LLVM's format, and appends it to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - The instruction to extract Mod, R/M, and SIB fields from.

briefdescription.para: translateRM - Translates an operand stored in the R/M (and possibly SIB) byte of an instruction to LLVM form, and appends it to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - The operand, as stored in the descriptor table.
- The instruction to extract Mod, R/M, and SIB fields from.

briefdescription.para: translateFPRegister - Translates a stack position on the FPU stack to its LLVM form, and appends it to an MCInst.
translateMaskRegister - Translates a 3-bit mask register number to LLVM form, and appends it to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - Number of mask register from 0 to 7.

briefdescription.para: translateOperand - Translates an operand stored in an internal instruction to LLVM's format and appends it to an MCInst.

parameterdescription.para: - The operand, as stored in the descriptor table.
